description: This file contains shell script tests for Git worktree operations including move, lock, unlock, and remove, with various scenarios and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Checks that a given path exists.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_config_global
